rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AB label and image as an expanded blastocyst with a discernible ICM and looser TE, but it overstates certainty on features like uniform zona thinning, upper-pole ICM location, and subtle vacuolation that are not clearly verifiable from this single image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior live birth/miscarriage, BMI, smoking, male factor, and endometrial thickness into prognosis well, though some links are overstated and not all factors are equally evidence-based.

The structure is logical and the probability estimate is explained, but several deductions are too confident or weakly supported, especially the magnitude assigned to BMI, stress, and smoking effects and the additive probability adjustments.

Core points on embryo grading and lifestyle optimization are aligned, but recommendations such as ERA after a single failed transfer in this context, uterine NK cell testing, NK activity panels, and broad thrombophilia/immune workup are not guideline-supported routine practice.

Provides clear practical steps for transfer optimization and future planning, especially smoking cessation and nutritional support, but some suggested investigations are not appropriately selective or evidence-based.
